scene: The ruby planet clicks, unfolding triple transit gates in the dome.
picture: A flat side view along the tiled dome floor. On the far left, a transparent glass elevator sits with open doors. Left of centre, the girl in her teal hoodie pauses in her purple wheelchair. In the centre, a miniature steam train puffs puffs on tracks. On the far right, a moored airship awaits passengers.
shown: a gleaming glass elevator shaft resting on the far left
a bright brass steam train idling on centre tracks
a striped airship moored to a gantry on the far right
